## Summary

Which issue or change this is. One per pull request.

## What changes

The files and behaviour, in words.

## Public surface

`none`, or what changed in a command's output or options, the manifest schema (`templates/dev.schema.json`),
a template, or a setting, and the tests and documentation changed with it.

## Checks

The summary block `scripts/dev/check.sh` printed (or `jpdev check`), and any check you ran another way.

## Sign-off

Every commit carries a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off that matches its author.
